'''Bev Tarmo''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] Commander for the [[Exchange]] who was active on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He was killed, alongside other Exchange bosses and Mandalorian leaders, by an individual in his [[Mandalorian outpost (Jundland Wastes)|outpost]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]].<ref name="Encounter" />
